body:
I can confirm the issue. This is a regression from PR #111011 and only happens when you use the `move/duplicate` on a file in the `res://` directory, which causes an infinite loop. When you do that, `parts` will be an array with only a empty string inside https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/16bb065ac31b79c0ed24b3b944d3b5275123e854/editor/gui/editor_dir_dialog.cpp#L138-L142
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/16bb065ac31b79c0ed24b3b944d3b5275123e854/editor/gui/editor_dir_dialog.cpp#L144-L150 With that the `while` loop will never end, because if you don't have sub-directories on `res://`, the `for` loop will never be called or if you have sub-directories, the `if` statment will always be `false` because no file will have an empty string as name.
Using `allow_empty = false` in the `split` call fixes the issue. I'll do a PR.
